seo.title: The Executioner Boss Guide: Act 1 Strategy (PoE2)
seo.description: Beat The Executioner in PoE2 Act 1: Ogham Village route, red slam tell, adds, positioning, preparation and quest progression.

sections.title: Encounter overview
paragraphs: The Executioner blocks the main Act 1 route through Ogham Village. His attacks are slow but heavily punish players who stay in front of him, and summoned mercenaries make the arena increasingly dangerous if left alive.
The safest plan is to circle at medium range, dodge sideways or through the boss after a committed wind-up, and clear ranged adds before the arena becomes crowded.
bullets: Location: Executioner's Block at the end of Ogham Village.
Primary threat: physical slams and frontal swings.
Quest result: progress The Trail of Corruption.

sections.title: Safe strategy
paragraphs: When the weapon rises or the boss flashes red, leave the frontal line. Roll to the side if far away, or through and behind him if already close. Attack only during the long recovery after a slam.
When he calls mercenaries, kill ranged attackers first and keep moving around the outer arena. Do not tunnel on the boss while projectiles and burning ground overlap.
bullets: Do not stand directly in front during a wind-up.
Clear adds before returning to damage.
Save one dodge for the red straight-line slam.

sections.title: Build preparation
paragraphs: Upgrade the main skill gem and weapon before entering Ogham Village. Fire resistance helps with the surrounding zone and burning hazards, while Life and a reliable movement skill prevent the heavy physical attacks from becoming one-shots.

items.question: Where is The Executioner?
answer: At the Executioner's Block at the end of Ogham Village in Act 1, generally toward the far side of the zone from the Waypoint.

items.question: What should I dodge?
answer: Prioritise the red or overhead slam tells and avoid remaining in front of the boss during wide swings.

items.question: What does the fight unlock?
answer: It advances The Trail of Corruption and opens the route toward the Manor Ramparts.
